_doc: c11 (critic C #3): per-onset legato lead offsets in seconds, {track: {score onset qn: s}}, matched within 0.02 qn, added to the family LEG_LEAD_S (plus LEG_EXTRA_S / LEG_PAIR_EXTRA_S); total clamped to 0.03-0.35 s.
